I found nothing in this draft that needs changing.

- **Claims:** "Our tea bags are plastic-free and home compostable" matches the allowlist wording exactly (supplier certificate, EN 13432). "Plastic-free tea bags" in the line before it is consistent with that.
- **Product facts:** New winter tins, deep green with gold lettering, count as new-product and product details, which the product team has already checked.
- **Urgency:** "Just landed" describes an arrival. It is not a countdown, a stock warning or a "today only" push.
- **Banned content:** There are no superlatives, guarantees, health claims, broader environmental claims, invented numbers or testimonials.
- **Voice and spelling:** The tone is plain and warm, none of the banned words appear, and nothing conflicts with UK spelling.
- **Disclosure:** This is a post from our own account, so no "Ad", "Gifted" or affiliate label is needed.

The plastic-free line is said twice in three sentences. That is a style point only, and you could trim it if you like.

Under policy section 6, Sam still needs to approve everything public, so get his sign-off before it goes live.
